instruction: King holding us from claiming completion of blogs and case studies. What is that one bloody case study
context: Recovery of /customers/donorschoose, the last enrichable case study. It had been quarantined by a span-distance gate its own retry could not satisfy: the gate measured max(end)-min(start) while the retry banned candidates on c.start only, so a span starting inside the window but ending 111 chars past it was always kept. Fixed in gates.py retry_constraints; the record then passed on the first attempt. validate PASS, 8/8 spans grounded.
scope: adds abstract_enriched and keyhighlights_enriched to 1 existing record via partialUpdateObject
